max.description: Maximum value for calculating remaining empty area, default: 100

circumference.description: Arc span in degrees: 360 for full circle, 270 for 3/4 circle, default: 270

legend.description: Whether to display the legend below the chart, default: false

fixedHeight.description: Fixed height of the chart in pixels (determines chart circumference), default: 320. The chart's circumference is always based on this fixed height to match other radial instruments.

minRingThickness.description: Minimum thickness of each ring in pixels, excluding borders, default: 16

data.description: The value of each ring, outermost first, as plain numbers on the scale 0 to `max` (the element's `data`).

colors.description: Colours of the series or segments in order, as CSS colour strings. Empty uses the palette of the scheme.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
